## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

A team's ability to generate large gains, as distinct from consistently gaining a few yards at a time.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

It is the quality the guide's yardage statistics are least able to capture. Yards per play averages a fifty-yard gain and nine two-yard gains into the same number as ten short ones.
